t: 约法会议会召开会议,以确定英国,爱尔兰和苏格兰最后一位罗马天主教君主詹姆斯二世和七世在1688…
te: The Convention Parliament convenes to determine whether James II and VII, the last Roman Catholic monarch of England, I…
dz: 约法会议会召开会议,以确定英国,爱尔兰和苏格兰最后一位罗马天主教君主詹姆斯二世和七世在1688年逃入法国时是否腾空了英格兰和爱尔兰的王位.
de: The Convention Parliament convenes to determine whether James II and VII, the last Roman Catholic monarch of England, Ireland and Scotland, had vacated the thrones of England and Ireland when he fled to France in 1688.

t: 约法会议会宣布,1688年由最后一位罗马天主教英国君主詹姆斯二世出逃至法国,构成弃权.
te: The Convention Parliament declares that the flight to France in 1688 by James II, the last Roman Catholic British monar…
dz: 约法会议会宣布,1688年由最后一位罗马天主教英国君主詹姆斯二世出逃至法国,构成弃权.
de: The Convention Parliament declares that the flight to France in 1688 by James II, the last Roman Catholic British monarch, constitutes an abdication.

t: 威廉三世和玛丽二世被宣布为英格兰的共同统治者.
te: William III and Mary II are proclaimed co-rulers of England.
dz: 威廉三世和玛丽二世被宣布为英格兰的共同统治者.
de: William III and Mary II are proclaimed co-rulers of England.

t: 英格兰的詹姆斯二世在金萨莱登陆,开始了爱尔兰的威廉特人战争.
te: James II of England lands at Kinsale, starting the Williamite War in Ireland.
dz: 英格兰的詹姆斯二世在金萨莱登陆,开始了爱尔兰的威廉特人战争.
de: James II of England lands at Kinsale, starting the Williamite War in Ireland.

t: 威廉三世和玛丽二世在苏格兰议会同意2月12日英国决定的同一天被加冕为大不列颠的联合君主.
te: William III and Mary II are crowned as joint sovereigns of Great Britain on the same day that the Scottish Parliament c…
dz: 威廉三世和玛丽二世在苏格兰议会同意2月12日英国决定的同一天被加冕为大不列颠的联合君主.
de: William III and Mary II are crowned as joint sovereigns of Great Britain on the same day that the Scottish Parliament concurs with the English decision of 12 February.

t: 波士顿人起而反抗埃德蒙·安德罗斯爵士.
te: Bostonians rise up in rebellion against Sir Edmund Andros.
dz: 波士顿人起而反抗埃德蒙·安德罗斯爵士.
de: Bostonians rise up in rebellion against Sir Edmund Andros.

t: 英国议会通过了"容忍法"来保护持异议的新教徒,但排除了罗马天主教徒.
te: The English Parliament passes the Act of Toleration protecting dissenting Protestants but excluding Roman Catholics.
dz: 英国议会通过了"容忍法"来保护持异议的新教徒,但排除了罗马天主教徒.
de: The English Parliament passes the Act of Toleration protecting dissenting Protestants but excluding Roman Catholics.

t: 基利克兰基之战是雅各布派的胜利。
te: The Battle of Killiecrankie is a victory for the Jacobites.
dz: 光荣革命：基利克兰基之战是雅各布派的胜利。
de: Glorious Revolution: The Battle of Killiecrankie is a victory for the Jacobites.

t: 1500名易洛魁人出击新法兰西的拉钦.
te: Fifteen hundred Iroquois attack Lachine in New France.
dz: 比弗战争:1500名易洛魁人出击新法兰西的拉钦.
de: Beaver Wars: Fifteen hundred Iroquois attack Lachine in New France.

te: The Battle of Dunkeld in Scotland.
de: The Battle of Dunkeld in Scotland.

t: "内尔琴斯克条约"由俄罗斯和清帝国签订(儒略历).
te: The Treaty of Nerchinsk is signed by Russia and the Qing Empire (Julian calendar).
dz: "内尔琴斯克条约"由俄罗斯和清帝国签订(儒略历).
de: The Treaty of Nerchinsk is signed by Russia and the Qing Empire (Julian calendar).

t: 奥地利的埃内亚·西尔维奥·皮科洛米尼将军烧倒了斯科普里,以防止霍乱蔓延;他不久后就死于该疾病.
te: General Enea Silvio Piccolomini of Austria burns down Skopje to prevent the spread of cholera; he dies of the disease s…
dz: 奥地利的埃内亚·西尔维奥·皮科洛米尼将军烧倒了斯科普里,以防止霍乱蔓延;他不久后就死于该疾病.
de: General Enea Silvio Piccolomini of Austria burns down Skopje to prevent the spread of cholera; he dies of the disease soon afterwards.

te: The Declaration of Right is embodied in the Bill of Rights.
dz: 公约议会:《权利宣言》载于《权利法案》.
de: Convention Parliament: The Declaration of Right is embodied in the Bill of Rights.
